# BingBloom

> Stream and download movies, TV shows, anime, live TV channels, podcasts, music and read novels — all in one corporate-grade cinematic streaming app. Stream. Discover. Bloom.

BingBloom is a free, ad-supported streaming platform aggregating entertainment from across the web: movies and TV from TMDB, anime from AniList/Jikan, 80+ live TV channels from IPTV-org, music from TheAudioDB and Deezer, and public-domain novels from Project Gutenberg and OpenLibrary. The web app is mobile-first and installable, and an Android APK is available for direct download.

## Featured pages

- [Home](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/home): Personalized dashboard — continue-watching, trending rows, top-rated and recommended.
- [Movies](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/movies): Browse, search and stream movies with full TMDB metadata, cast and crew.
- [TV Shows](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/tv): Browse TV series with seasons and episode tracking.
- [Anime](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/anime): Anime catalog with episode lists.
- [Animation](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/animation): Animated films and series.
- [Documentary](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/documentary): Documentary films and series.
- [Live TV](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/live-tv): 80+ live TV channels worldwide.
- [Novels](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/novels): Read free public-domain novels in the in-app reader.
- [Podcasts](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/podcasts): Podcast discovery and playback.
- [Music](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/music): Music browser with persistent player bar.
- [Search](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/search): Universal search across all sources.
- [My Downloads](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/my-downloads): Manage saved/offline content.
- [Install App](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/install): Free Android APK download with install guide.
- [Follow Us](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/follow-us): Official TikTok, Instagram and WhatsApp channels.
- [Profile](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/profile): Stats, history and account.
- [Settings](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/settings): Playback, quality and 20+ preferences.
